notes: Quarterly (3 months to 31 March 2025 = year to date). First IFRS 17 interim year (2567 comparatives restated). Scanned; read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers). Reviewed, not audited (PwC). Baht, face and notes. SCI p.5. No PAA business. Revenue and expenses from 21.1 (p.84, 3 months, both years). In this edition note 15.1.2 (CSM roll-forward, p.67-68) and 15.1.3 (new business, p.71) print every balance and movement with the opposite sign (insurance contract balances negative), as FWD does: those rules carry sign -1 (the PV inflow of new business, printed positive, keeps +1). Future-service change = change in estimates + the onerous-contract estimate line, which carries CSM this quarter (CSM column). 15.1.3 has one total column that adds the 31 มีนาคม 2568 and 31 ธันวาคม 2567 columns together, so the two 2568 columns (non-onerous + onerous) are summed instead; they reconcile within 20 Baht. The loss component is a net reversal in the quarter (352,087,389). Other expense = other finance costs + other operating expenses + other expenses. In Q1 the three-month profit or loss is the year-to-date column.
